title: A lane session cannot write in the main checkout
body:
Why: 2026-11-13 the ci-wait lane edited src/ci/wait.ts and src/deliver/admission-policy.ts in the main checkout instead of its worktree (lead moved them to branch ci-wait-wip). lanes.md says own worktree, but nothing refuses it.
Outcome: a PreToolUse hook in lane sessions refuses Edit/Write/Bash writes under the repository root outside .krn/worktrees/<own slug> and .krn/runs; test with a lane-session fixture.
